title: Pointwise CATE Estimation under Only a Positive Band on the Design Density
banked_reason: D0.5.G tier=subfield < floor=field: sound close-pair KBRW-rate achievability under a fixed positive density band, but no matching positive-band converse.
gap_reasons: What is actually proved is a one-sided achievability result: a pair-difference U-statistic local R-estimator attains the ALREADY-PUBLISHED KBRW exponent.
The two endpoints have strictly different exponents (t<q), so nothing about the band-only exponent is determined.

The fixed-uniform-density KBRW converse is inadmissible: KBRW's cancellation uses flat-top support holes; restoring a positive lower band leaves an uncancelled O(h^{2gamma}) term and only the oracle exponent.
proof_attempt_summary: The run attempted to prove that an unknown, unsmooth positive-band design density forces a pointwise CATE minimax slowdown relative to the KBRW benchmark. The density-coupled converse collapsed because the available KBRW cancellation relies on support holes; the repaired derivation instead proves that a total close-pair local R-estimator attains the KBRW rate on a nonempty restricted region without density estimation or density smoothness. The exact positive-band minimax exponent, a matching converse, extension beyond the close-pair region, and logarithm removal remain open.
tldr: A total close-pair local \(R\)-estimator attains the Kennedy--Balakrishnan--Robins--Wasserman benchmark rate on the nonempty region \(\mathcal R_{\mathrm{pair}}\) using only the fixed density band \(f_{-}\leq f_P\leq f_{+}\), with no density estimator or density smoothness.  The proved positive-band minimax bracket is \(c n^{-q}\leq R_n^{\mathrm{band}}\leq Cn^{-t}=Cr_n^{\mathrm{KBRW}}\) with \(t<q\), so exact minimaxity and a matching positive-band converse remain open.  A broader rank-capped estimator gives the stated logarithmically inflated upper bound on \(\mathcal R_{\mathrm{low}}\).
gap: The density-qualified pointwise CATE benchmark is known, but under only a fixed positive band on an otherwise arbitrary design density there was no primitive, density-free estimator verification at that benchmark and there is still no matching positive-band converse.  Existing empirical higher-order influence-function results concern global functionals or projection dimensions below the relevant sample rank and do not determine this localized frontier.
fill: The note constructs a total pair-difference \(U\)-statistic estimator and proves the compact-uniform risk bound \(h^\gamma+\ell^{\alpha+\beta}+(nh^d)^{-1/2}+(n^2h^d\ell^d)^{-1/2}\), optimized at \(n^{-t}=r_n^{\mathrm{KBRW}}\).  It combines this estimator with the oracle pointwise-regression lower branch to give the honest bracket \(c n^{-q}\leq R_n^{\mathrm{band}}\leq Cn^{-t}\), while retaining the broader rank-capped fallback outside the close-pair region.
